Frequently asked questions

What is Maskan?

A marketplace that connects property seekers with real estate agencies. We don't own, sell, value or negotiate properties.

How do I contact an agency?

Every property page has call and WhatsApp buttons and an inquiry form that goes to the agency.

Who is responsible for listing details?

The listing agency is responsible for the accuracy of prices, availability and photos.

Are you a real estate agency?

Give each property its own page, searchable by location and type, with inquiries sent straight to you. Search visibility builds over time and is not guaranteed.
